collections_ownership_check.name: collections_ownership_check
collections_ownership_check.value: ("collections"."ownership_type"='site' AND "collections"."owner_id" IS NULL) OR ("collections"."ownership_type"='user' AND "collections"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "collections"."kind"='person' AND "collections"."visibility"='admin')

collections_kind_scope_check.name: collections_kind_scope_check
collections_kind_scope_check.value: ("collections"."kind" = 'folder' AND "collections"."library_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("collections"."kind" IN ('manual', 'person') AND "collections"."library_id" IS NULL)

collections_manual_identity_check.name: collections_manual_identity_check
collections_manual_identity_check.value: "collections"."kind" != 'manual' OR ("collections"."title" IS NOT NULL AND "collections"."uid" IS NOT NULL)

people_ownership_check.name: people_ownership_check
people_ownership_check.value: ("people"."ownership_type"='site' AND "people"."owner_id" IS NULL) OR ("people"."ownership_type"='user' AND "people"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL)

photo_files_checksum_check.name: photo_files_checksum_check
photo_files_checksum_check.value: "photo_files"."checksum_sha256" IS NULL OR (length("photo_files"."checksum_sha256")=64 AND "photo_files"."checksum_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')

photo_files_billable_check.name: photo_files_billable_check
photo_files_billable_check.value: "photo_files"."is_billable_original"=0 OR ("photo_files"."locator_type"='provider' AND "photo_files"."role" IN ('original','live_video') AND "photo_files"."upload_relative_path" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_files"."checksum_sha256" IS NOT NULL)

photo_files_locator_check.name: photo_files_locator_check
photo_files_locator_check.value: ("photo_files"."locator_type"='provider' AND "photo_files"."storage_provider_id" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_files"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_files"."library_id" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."library_path" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."parent_file_id" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."byte_offset" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."byte_length" IS NULL) OR ("photo_files"."locator_type"='library' AND "photo_files"."library_id" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_files"."library_path" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_files"."storage_provider_id" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."storage_key" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."parent_file_id" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."byte_offset" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."byte_length" IS NULL) OR ("photo_files"."locator_type"='embedded' AND "photo_files"."parent_file_id" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_files"."byte_offset" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_files"."byte_length" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_files"."byte_offset">=0 AND "photo_files"."byte_length">0 AND "photo_files"."storage_provider_id" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."storage_key" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."library_id" IS NULL AND "photo_files"."library_path" IS NULL)

transfer_file_locator_check.name: transfer_file_locator_check
transfer_file_locator_check.value: ("photo_transfer_files"."locator_type"='provider' AND "photo_transfer_files"."storage_provider_id" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_transfer_files"."source_key" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_transfer_files"."target_key" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_transfer_files"."parent_file_id" IS NULL) OR ("photo_transfer_files"."locator_type"='embedded' AND "photo_transfer_files"."storage_provider_id" IS NULL AND "photo_transfer_files"."source_key" IS NULL AND "photo_transfer_files"."target_key" IS NULL AND "photo_transfer_files"."parent_file_id" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_transfer_files"."byte_offset" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_transfer_files"."byte_length" IS NOT NULL AND "photo_transfer_files"."byte_offset">=0 AND "photo_transfer_files"."byte_length">0)

idx_photos_geo_timeline.name: idx_photos_geo_timeline
idx_photos_geo_timeline.where: "photos"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "photos"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "photos"."longitude" IS NOT NULL

photos_ownership_check.name: photos_ownership_check
photos_ownership_check.value: ("photos"."ownership_type"='site' AND "photos"."owner_id" IS NULL AND "photos"."visibility"='inherit') OR ("photos"."ownership_type"='user' AND "photos"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "photos"."visibility" IN ('private','public','shared'))

photos_personal_source_check.name: photos_personal_source_check
photos_personal_source_check.value: "photos"."ownership_type"!='user' OR ("photos"."source"='upload' AND "photos"."library_id" IS NULL AND "photos"."library_mount" IS NULL AND "photos"."library_path" IS NULL AND "photos"."preserve_original"=1)

user_deletion_mode_check.name: user_deletion_mode_check
user_deletion_mode_check.value: ("user_deletion_tasks"."mode"='purge' AND "user_deletion_tasks"."target_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("user_deletion_tasks"."mode"='transfer' AND "user_deletion_tasks"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_deletion_tasks"."target_user_id"!="user_deletion_tasks"."user_id")

users_username_check.name: users_username_check
users_username_check.value: length("users"."username") BETWEEN 3 AND 32 AND "users"."username" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND "users"."username" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_-]*' AND "users"."username" NOT IN ('con','prn','aux','nul','com1','com2','com3','com4','com5','com6','com7','com8','com9','lpt1','lpt2','lpt3','lpt4','lpt5','lpt6','lpt7','lpt8','lpt9')
